indicator.name: Women age 15–49 literacy rate
indicator.description: Percentage of women age 15–49 classified as literate in the corrected 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey Table 3.3.1C.
indicator.expected_source: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey 2022, corrected Table 3.3.1C
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published for all 47 counties for women age 15–49. The source-reported weighted number of women is retained as survey precision metadata; this is not a combined-sex literacy rate.

observations.notes: Direct corrected KDHS 2022 Table 3.3.1C percentage literate among women age 15–49. Published weighted denominator retained; no standard error or confidence interval is fabricated and ranking is withheld.
